reviews.text: Corey has been a great help when I moved to north Greenpoint and needed to find a new dogwalker. Easy to book, punctual and sends great daily pics!

Corey has been a life saver for my high energy aussiedoodle. My dog is always very excited to see Corey, and comes back from walks/hikes very happy.  The hikes are a great way to get out energy, and Corey is always very responsive and sends lots of pictures ! I would highly recommend him.

Corey is fantastic, and so dedicated to the pups!! I have used him for walks, hikes to the beach and dog sitting. All services have exceeded my expectations & my pup loves him. Corey is hard working, enthusiastic, a great communicator & shows my pup so much love. I know my dog Milo is in good hands with Corey & the team at NYC Doggystyle!

Corey has been fantastic for my dog, Poppy. He is trustworthy, communicative, and Poppy is always happy when she sees Corey! The hikes are a really great deal as Poppy gets time to run and play with other dogs that she would not otherwise get in the city. I highly recommend Corey if you’re looking for dog walking in Brooklyn.
Corey is fantastic! My dog Hamida is very shy and stand offish, and he’s been great with her - she even has other dog buddies to walk with now!
Corey is awesome! He’s been taking our pup Isaac out on excursions for around the last year and I am so grateful to have this living in the city. 10/10 recommend!
Corey is great with our dog- very reliable and has an easy system for booking!

We and most importantly our dog LOVE Corey. Our little hound mix can be sensitive with people and he was immediately best friends with Corey. Even when Ollie was recovering from cancer treatments Corey checked in to make sure he was ok and was extra caring of him on walks and adventures together. We couldn't recommend NYC Doggystyle enough!!

Corey has been such a great help to our lives over the past 9 months, and our dog absolutely LOVES him! Whether it’s the multi-hour expeditions to the beach where our dog gets to run around and swim with other dogs, nice long walks around the neighborhood, or overnights when we are out of town, Corey always provides a much needed helping hand with our dog when we are just a little too busy to get him proper exercise!

We especially appreciate the amazing photos Corey sends of the dogs!
Corey is professional and incredibly reliable, and our dog has so much fun on the walks and beach trips that Corey takes him on. Highly recommend!

Corey has saved me more times than I can count! When I had an emergency last weekend and asked if he could help with my dog, Corey didn't hesitate to take care of him.  It's such a relief to have someone you can rely on to look after your pet! He also takes great photo updates through the walk or day, if you opt for the hikes!

Corey is incredible with our pups and we especially love the extra services he offers like hikes and beach days. He’s also a ninja when he picks them up from our apartment and doesn’t make a sound. I’m still wanting a lesson in these skills. Thankful to have Corey for our pups. 10/10 would recommend
Corey takes amazing care of our little buddy. He is consistent yet flexible with us and sends pictures to let us know he is okay. A plus, he always makes our dog look like a model!

Hikes with Corey and NYC Doggystyle are a highlight of Kenny’s week! Kenny has been hiking with Corey and his crew of besties for a few years and knows Corey by name, is always waiting for him at the door and comes home happy and exhausted.
Our dog Tuna goes once a week for a beach hike and has always enjoyed the time with Corey and other dogs. Highly recommended!

Corey has been our dogwalker for several months and I can't recommend him highly enough. He's reliable, communicative, and takes great pics of our dog on his walks! Even when he takes a vacation, he ensures there's a reliable walker to still take care of our pup in his stead. Easy to book/confirm and many options for what our dog needs in terms of times and length of walks.

Corey is the best dog walker we've ever worked with! He is reliable, consistent and flexible. I love that he always sends pictures which put me at east and most importantly I love that our energetic Samoyed absolutely loves him. He always comes back from his walks and beach trips in a good mood and I can always trust that he is in good hands.
Corey has also taken our pup on a few beach trips, and it always makes my day to see all the pictures and videos of happy dogs playing on the beach. I completely trust Corey to work with his recall issues on these trips and cannot wait to book more in the fall.
I’m so thankful I found Corey! My dog is 10 years old and has some behavioral quirks but Corey is so understanding and good with him. He’s always so happy to see Corey for a walk or beach run! …
Corey and his team are excellent walkers. He has never once missed a walk and my dog loves him. Highly recommend.

Corey is the best — his service is always reliable and consistent, and our dog, Ennui, has the best time and returns home happy and exhausted. Also, Corey takes incredible photos on the hikes — getting the album afterward has become an exciting tradition. Can’t recommend highly enough!
